title: Final Capacitance Value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct numerical value for the capacitance C.

title: Correct Formula Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the capacitance formula C = ε/(σR) correctly from the given laws.

title: Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and use the values for ε and σ in the calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Potential Difference Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate the potential difference V to the resistance R and current I.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes in calculations, such as sign errors or incorrect factor usage.

title: Final Equation Presentation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present the final equation clearly and in a standard format.
